simple.meaning: דָּמָה (dâmâh) appears 16 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Lamentations, Hosea, and 2 more, beginning at Psalms 49:13. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דָּמָה (H1820) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows דָּמָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: דָּמָה (dâmâh) / H1820 is tracked through Psalms 49:13, Psalms 49:21, Isaiah 6:5, Isaiah 15:1. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.usage: cease, be cut down (off), destroy, be brought to silence, be undone, × utterly.
definitions.full: H1820. damah II. [ דָּמָה ] verb cease, cause to cease, cut off, destroy — Qal Perfect 1singular דָּמִיתִי Jer 6:2 , וְדָמִ֫יתִי consecutive Hosea 4:5 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular תִּדְמֶה Lam 3:49 ; 3 feminine plural jussive תִּדְמֶינָה Jer 14:17 ; — 1 intransitive cease Jer 14:17 (eyes from weeping) Lam 3:49 ( id. ) 2 cause to cease, cut off, destroy , with accusative Israel (under figure of בתצֿיון ) Jer 6:2 ; (under figure of אִמֶּ֑ךָ ) Hosea 4:5 . Niph`al Perfect נִדְמָה Isa 15:1 (twice in verse) +; 3feminine singular נִדְמְתָה Jeremiah 47:15; 2 masculine singular נִדְמֵיתָה Obadiah 5, נִדְמֵיתָ Ezek 32:2 ; 1 singular נִדְמֵיתִי Isa 6:5 ; 3 plural נִדְמוּ Hosea 4:6 +; Infinitive absolute נִדְמֹה 10:15 ; Participle נִדְמֶה 10:7 ; be cut off, destroyed, ruined , of a city Isa 15:1 (twice in verse) (|| שֻׁדַּד ) Jer 47:5 ; of people Hosea 4:6 ; Zeph 1:11 ; Obadiah 5; of king Hosea 10:7 , 15 (twice in verse) compare Ezek 32:2 ; of beasts Psa 49:13 ; Psalm 49:21; be ruined, undone , prophet at sight of Yahweh Isa 6:5 .
